comments.why: Short clip on an acid trip and HyperCard's origins.
comments.text: Bill Atkinson was a very fascinating guy. His interview with Leo Laporte from 2013 is a great listen. Here's a little 6 minute clip: An acid trip, and the origins of Hypercard. [VIDEO]

comments.author: willio58
comments.why: Atkinson describing HyperCard's origin on LSD.
comments.text: HyperCard was before my time but I love learning about it. It's pretty easy to draw a line from HyperCard to the web and web apps we all use today. It's also funny because the creator of HyperCard (Bill Atkinson) thought up the idea wall on LSD on a park bench: [VIDEO]

comments.author: pwdisswordfish9
comments.why: Atkinson says HyperCard was inspired by an LSD trip.
comments.text: From the Laporte interview: "I'm 65. I can tell things I wouldn't [have] told if I were earlier. Hypercard was inspired by an LSD trip." [VIDEO]
